title: AI Agent Body
description: That one machine key is the body of one AI agent: requests that key signs speak as the AI agent, at the grade recorded here, while this is unrevoked.

u.description: Salt, when the credential is issued private

i.description: Issuer: the identity that owns the asset

ri.description: The registry the grant is issued in, where its revocation is recorded

u.description: Salt, when the attributes are issued private

i.description: The asset's identifier: the holder of this grant

asset_type.description: The kind of asset this grant is for

name.description: The asset's name when the grant was issued

valid_until.description: When the grant lapses. Absent, it holds until revoked

host.description: The body's identifier, derived from its key

keys_digest.description: Digest of the body's identifier, signing key and sealing keys, as the body signed it at enrolment

grade.description: How strongly the body's key is held. hardware-asserted is the machine's own unverified word; the attested grades are recorded only once their evidence has been verified

claimed_grade.description: The grade the machine claimed, kept so a claim lowered to grade is visible to whoever reads this

platform.description: The platform the body reported, e.g. macos/arm64

placement.description: Where the body is: computer, vm, cloud or device
